videoMotionBlueprints.title: Sequence Alpha (Living Syntactic Glider Emission)
videoMotionBlueprints.toolTarget: Runway Gen-3 / OpenAI Sora / Google Veo
videoMotionBlueprints.prompt: Cinematic 60fps ultra-fluid shot: An obsidian black display board illuminated by a fine grid of phosphor-green square cells. The word 'EMERGENCE' stands sharply defined. Suddenly, the serifs of the letters begin to oscillate in Conway's Game of Life patterns. From each letter, tiny five-cell gliders detach and march diagonally across the empty dark space between words, colliding with punctuation marks that burst into pulsating cellular blossoms before restabilizing. Photorealistic phosphor persistence glow, 4k.
